status: Examiner's spec for engine/render and engine/providers/render. 0.2.0 applies Codex's review of PR #6 (fixtures/core/RENDER_INTERFACE_REVIEW.md): request and response shapes are now contracts/render-api.schema.json; hatching comes from conventions.hatches (profile.schema 0.2.0); the fixture provider is bound when the test app is built.

job_status.returns: job_status; the tests poll until the state is no longer queued or running

provider_kwargs.stills: list of image paths inside fixtures/render/fidelity, one per still attempt; the last repeats
provider_kwargs.video_outcomes: list of ok | moderation_failed, one per preview attempt, each attempt on a different catalogue model

rules: Tests build a fresh app per case with create_app(render_provider=FixtureProvider(...)), so sequences never carry over between jobs or tests.
Only the provider's output is substituted. Conditioning, fidelity scoring, retries, alternate-model selection, labels, start-still checks, material basis and metering run on the production path.
Production configuration cannot select the fixture provider: no environment variable or request field reaches it.
The provider reads only files inside fixtures/render/fidelity and makes no network calls.

object_group.note: data-material-id is empty when the object has no material

svg.hatch: an element inside the object group whose fill is url(#id), where #id is a <pattern> in <defs> carrying data-hatch-pattern=<conventions.hatches[category].pattern_id>. Pattern ids are prefixed per drawing so several SVGs can share a page.
svg.line_weights: stroke-width of each layer's geometry is proportional to conventions.line_weights_mm[layer name]; dimensions use line_weights_mm["A-Dims"]
svg.units_note: Only ratios of stroke widths are tested, so any scale or unit choice passes.

dxf.xdata: 1000-group strings "object_id:<id>", "dimension_id:<id>" or "annotation_id:<id>", plus "source:<source>" and "verify:<true|false>" on objects and their HATCH entities
dxf.layers: one DXF layer per DDL layer, named with the layer's name
dxf.hatch: a HATCH entity carrying the object's xdata for every object whose material category has a pattern in conventions.hatches
dxf.dimensions: a DIMENSION entity per displayed DDL dimension whose measurement equals the value
